{{Quote|What's wrong with Officer Fybot, and why in the name of the Eternal is he smiling in that idiotic way?''"<br />"''Shock, perhaps. He's broken both his legs&mdash;rather, I've broken both his legs. I'm having a bit of trouble regretting it very much, considering the circumstances. Although I wish I knew how to examine him for further damage. I don't know where he's supposed to bend, let alone where he isn't.|[[Bassi Vobah]] and Lando Calrissian, examining Waywa Fybot after a resting rack accident|<ref name="LCATFOO 8">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]'', Chapter 8.</ref>}}
A '''resting rack''' or '''sleeping rack''' was a device used by the [[Quor'sav/Legends|Quor'sav]] to perch and sleep upon. It vaguely resembled two [[sawhorse]]s<ref name="LCATFOO 8" /> connected by a bar.<ref name="LCATFOO 11">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]'', Chapter 11.</ref> When a Quor'sav perched and rested upon the structure, the posture triggered a sleep reflex which made the avian become drowsy.<ref name="LCATFOO 8" /> Many Quor'sav found this comforting and restful,<ref name="LCATFOO 9">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]'', Chapter 9.</ref> although the way the device fit around the body could be dangerous should it fall over. In [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]], police officer [[Waywa Fybot]] broke his legs when his resting rack toppled during a dogfight involving the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], upon which he was a passenger.<ref name="LCATFOO 11" /> For seating, the Quor'sav utilized a [[seating rack]].<ref name="LCATFOO 9" />
